Hi Irene / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Skyline is excited to move forward with the Order Form. Procurement had a few quick items related to insurance before we can route to our procurement tech stack:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI): they asked that Redwood provide a COI naming “Skyline Cloud Services, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates” as Additional Insured.
- Endorsement: they prefer an ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent endorsement attached to the COI.
- Timing: our broker has warned that final insurer endorsements can take 10–14 business days. Procurement asked whether you can accept a provisional COI or broker binder in the meantime so we can sign the Order Form and get the work scheduled.

I’m attaching the draft Order Form and the COI template Skyline requested. Can you confirm Redwood’s standard stance on: additional insured naming, acceptance of provisional/binder evidence, and whether you need a waiver of subrogation or primary/non-contributory language in the endorsement?

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: COI & endorsement wording for Order Form (Skyline)

Irene / Laura —

Thanks for the context. Legal is OK in principle to accept a binder/provisional COI with these firm caveats:

- Minimum limits must match the Order Form: Commercial General Liability $2M aggregate / $1M per occurrence (or the limits stated in the attached redline).
- Additional Insured: the COI should name “Skyline Cloud Services, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates\" and the policy must provide Additional Insured status on a primary and non-contributory basis where available. If the insurer refuses primary/non-contributory, we need written confirmation of the limitation.
- Endorsement: we prefer ISO CG 20 10 (or manuscript equivalent) attached to the COI. If not attached at time of Order Form signature, the binder must include insurer confirmation that the endorsement will be added within 30 days.
- Waiver of Subrogation: not required as a contractual default, but accept if the insurer is willing. If Skyline requires waiver of subrogation in writing, we can consider adding language to the Order Form.
- Notice of cancellation/non-renewal: 30 days prior notice required where legally permitted.

Exception path (temporary measure we can approve):
- Accept broker-issued provisional COI showing limits and naming Additional Insured + broker letter confirming endorsement will be issued within 30 calendar days after the Effective Date.
- Redwood legal reserves the right to pause services if final endorsement is not received within that 30-day window.

Please route the broker binder and any insurer correspondence to legal@redwood.com and contracts@redwood.com. I’ve added a couple of suggested redlines to the Order Form PDF (see HubSpot link).

Aditya Rao
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/78324/contact/98421 (Order Form redline)
